_doc: The idea shelf (M59.S). Seeded at M-D5.F from Asi's 2026-10-11 vetting and the owner's 19:42 QA list, so the Hardware Tier Panel lists real vetted tools under 'منتظر ارتقا' instead of UNKNOWN. Every tier tag below is a tier the vetting actually assigned; where the vetting left a tool's hardware fit unverified the tag is null, and the panel deliberately does not list such a tool as awaiting an upgrade it was never said to need. Provenance for each entry is the vetting record in reports/grok/queue_2050/; est_ram_mb is omitted everywhere because no vetting line gave a number, and no number is invented.
